textTemplates.description: Stores the body of the email notifying the recipients about the list of records that the flow failed to create for asset registration.
textTemplates.name: FailureEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Hi {!notificationRecipientName},

We couldn’t create the following records either due to insufficient data or because the following records already exist: {!failedRecordList}. The warranty term records can be related to existing asset warranties for either the parent asset or one or more child assets. The milestone and entitlement records exist for the parent asset.

textTemplates.description: Stores the body of the email notifying the recipients about the list of records created for asset registration, and the list of records that the flow failed to create.
textTemplates.name: PartialSuccessEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Hi {!notificationRecipientName},

We successfully created the following records for asset registration. {!createdRecordList}. The warranty term records are related to either the parent asset or one or more child assets. The milestone and entitlement records are related to the parent asset.

We couldn’t create the following records either due to insufficient data or because the following records already exist: {!failedRecordList}. The warranty term records can be related to existing asset warranties for either the parent asset or one or more child assets. The milestone and entitlement records exist for the parent asset.

textTemplates.description: Stores the body of the email notifying the recipients about the list of records successfully created for asset registration.
textTemplates.name: SuccessEmailBodyTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Hi {!notificationRecipientName},

We successfully created the following records for asset registration. {!createdRecordList}. The warranty term records are related to either the parent asset or one or more child assets. The milestone and entitlement records are related to the parent asset.
